name: Retro Americana
signature: Cream paper, navy ink, signal red, thick borders, offset shadows, a stamped badge.

contrast.note: Light theme. Red is safe as text on both backgrounds. Cream labels on red buttons pass AA.

type.eyebrow: 0.875rem, weight 600, uppercase, 0.2em tracking, red, between two thin navy rules

motion.rule: Stamp: blocks scale from 0.92 to full size in 400ms with a 60ms stagger, like a rubber stamp landing.
use: data-count-to for a real founding year

hero.layout: Real photo in a 6px navy border with a 10px offset navy shadow beside the headline. A round stamped badge overlaps the photo corner and shows the real founding year or a real fact. Two thin rules (navy and red) above the headline.
hero.photo: Real photo of the shop front, the sign, or the owner; black and white is allowed.

background: Cream paper with a 5% opacity SVG noise grain. A double rule (3px navy over 3px red) separates sections. Surface color is used for one sign-style band.

button.fill: Accent fill, cream label, 3px navy border, 4px offset navy shadow.
button.label: Uppercase, weight 700, 0.06em tracking.
button.hover: Press moves the button 2px down-right using data-press; shadow stays put.
